versions.changelog:
Initial release of douyin-search-guaikei:

- Enables Douyin (抖音) data analysis including hot search, keyword/video/image search, author post tracking, and comment insights.
- Supports filtering and sorting by likes, publish time, duration, and content type.
- Allows fetching real-time hot topics, public post lists by author, and video comment analysis.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for API access.
- Only processes public Douyin data; does not support login-required, private, or non-Douyin platforms.
- Outputs structured JSON for easy analysis and report generation.
